input.memo_markdown:
*All data is synthetic.*

## Last week's moves
First run. There was nothing to review.

## What's happening
- **LinkedIn:** 0 conversions since 10/18 on $5,417 over 14 days. Daily spend rose from $275 to $477. Before that it ran at $152 CPA and 1.2 ROAS, with 9-14 conversions a week.
- **Meta:** CPA was about $60 before 9/28 and about $91 after (1.5x). Last-3-week CPA is $87 vs $65 earlier. Spend is flat at about $3.4k/wk. Reported ROAS is 2.0, down from 3.1.
- **Google Search:** CPA is $15.6, the best trend of the paid channels. The September spike (+87% spend) did not hurt CPA ($20.82 vs about $19).
- **Email:** CPA is $14.9-21.6 on about $280/wk. No problem.
- **Direct:** conversions went from 2.0/day to 7.7/day (3.9x) from 10/11. Weekly direct conversions are 55 vs a 46.75 prior 4-week average. Self-reported "AI assistant" plus "Asked ChatGPT" answers rose from about 8% to 22%. The weekly figure was 22.2% for the week of 10/26. Paid spend rose only 1.04x.

## Moves
- **LinkedIn:** $450/day to $0. This is pure waste or broken tracking. Re-enabling is easy once tracking is verified.
- **Meta:** $500/day to $425 (-15%). The CPA rise is large and sustained. Its implied ROAS is 2.74-4.07 under all models, above the 1.5 target, so I made only a modest trim.
- **Google Search and Email:** no change.

## Where the models disagree
- **Google Search:** credit share is 40% (first-touch) to 69% (last-touch), implied ROAS 5.9-10.2. It is above target under every model. Last-touch likely overstates it.
- **Email:** credit share is 4% (last-touch) to 23% (first-touch), implied ROAS 9.3-53. It is far above target under all models, so it is likely underfunded. Its true value is unknown, so I scaled nothing.
- **LinkedIn:** implied ROAS is 0.98-1.97, borderline against the 1.5 target. The pause rests on the zero-result week, not on the models.

## Test to run
1. **Meta:** geo holdout (about 20% of regions, 3-4 weeks). Measure total conversions across all channels. Audit pixel/CAPI health around 9/28.
2. **Direct/AI:** capture AI-referral traffic and add an AI option to the survey. Confirm the cause before crediting or shifting any paid budget.

## Confidence
Medium overall. High on the LinkedIn pause, medium on the Meta trim. I'd change my mind on Meta if the holdout shows it is highly incremental, or if a tracking break explains the CPA rise. I'd change my mind on LinkedIn if tracking proves broken and conversions are really occurring.
